done_when: The handoff says 40 generated skills and passes the repository Markdown prose rule.

No credential value, automatic model switch, trust decision, resource discovery hook, tool interception, or lifecycle implementation exists in the source.

done_when: A low-level retry or compaction increments one settled run rather than emitting premature completion, and only `agent_settled` finalizes the record.
